en: Keyboard Pocket shows the disk space used by temporary folder transfers. Copying the same unchanged folder again reuses its ZIP.
Lab checks for unused transfers at startup, on wake and hourly while running. ZIPs used by slots, Undo or Smart Clipboard history remain available.
zh-CN: 键盘口袋显示文件夹传输缓存占用的硬盘空间。重复复制同一个未改动的文件夹会复用已有 ZIP。
Lab 在启动、唤醒和运行期间每小时检查过期传输。槽位、撤销记录或智能剪贴板历史仍在使用的 ZIP 会保留。
